component.name: Brave Music
component.summary: Ad-free YouTube Music, Spotify, and Offline Music OTT Platform

description.p: Brave Music is an open-source, privacy-first Linux desktop Music OTT platform developed by Codemo Open Source Labs (COSL). It combines ad-free YouTube Music, Spotify Web with Widevine DRM playback, a high-bitrate audio downloader, and an offline local music library into a single native desktop window.

ul.li: Unified tabbed navigation across Home, YouTube Music, Spotify, Downloads, and Offline Library
Built-in Brave Shields network and cosmetic ad-blocking for uninterrupted streaming
Hardware-accelerated 60fps UI with native Linux MPRIS2 media key and system tray integration
100% local execution with zero telemetry, zero analytics, and no cloud tracking

description.p: Official multi-format Linux desktop release (.deb, .snap, and .flatpak) featuring hardware-accelerated 60fps scrolling, single-instance desktop lock, updated official mascot icon, and streamlined About dialog.
